doc.summary: Data models for the claude_md_orchestrator skill.
doc.description:
The orchestrator is a pure data pipeline. Every agent reads its inputs
from disk, mutates an immutable dataclass, and writes the result back to
disk. The shape of those dataclasses is the contract between the
agents.

doc.summary: Pipeline stages the orchestrator walks through in order.

attributes.name: PENDING
attributes.description: the contract has been parsed but no agent has run.

attributes.name: SDD
attributes.description: the spec agent has produced the spec.

attributes.name: TDD
attributes.description: the test agent has produced the failing tests.

attributes.name: BDD
attributes.description: the implementation agent has produced the source.

attributes.name: REVIEW
attributes.description: the reviewer agent has produced the report.

attributes.name: CICD
attributes.description: the cicd agent has produced the branch and the pipeline.

attributes.name: DONE
attributes.description: every stage finished and the human signalled deploy.

doc.summary: Severity levels the reviewer emits.

attributes.name: INFO
attributes.description: cosmetic note. Never a blocker.

attributes.name: WARN
attributes.description:
deviation from the DoD that the boy scout can fix in a
follow up. The reviewer reports it but lets the cycle
continue when reviewer_strict is False.

attributes.name: BLOCK
attributes.description: violation of the DoD. The cycle halts until the agent fixes the artifact.

doc.summary: A single actionable contract parsed from CLAUDE.md.

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description:
Stable identifier the orchestrator uses to wire
the files together. The parser derives the value from the
markdown section number when present.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Short label the agents log with.

attributes.name: rationale
attributes.description: One paragraph that explains why the contract exists.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Bullet list of what the contract must deliver.

attributes.name: source_section
attributes.description: Heading path inside CLAUDE.md the parser extracted the contract from.

attributes.name: raw_text
attributes.description: Verbatim markdown the parser used. Kept so the documentation agent can quote the source.
